name: GPU-Optimized Perlin Noise (BBS)
definition: A GPU-optimized variant of Perlin noise that uses gradients from hypercube corners (not edge centers or unit sphere) and replaces hash lookups with a computable Blum-Blum-Shub generator.
summary: GPU-Optimized Perlin Noise (BBS) eliminates permutation tables by using a Blum-Blum-Shub hash and corner gradients, enabling efficient GPU computation via dimension-reducible 2D texture lookups.
